title: 第 14 章 功德加身天道压制削弱第 15 章 赵小胖登场死忠小弟就位
lines: 陆衍收到小胖传来的急报，脚步骤然加快，直奔宗门议事大殿。方才救助林安收获的功德还在体内缓缓流转，淡淡的金光萦绕周身，原本时不时缠上身的霉运怪事已经彻底消失，就连赶路时迎面刮来的狂风都绕着身子散开，良心积攒的好处实实在在落在身上。
赵小胖抱着厚厚一叠笔录证据紧跟在后，脸蛋急得通红：“少爷，方才我趴在殿外偷听，苏辰话术玩得太溜，又是卖惨出身贫寒，又是许诺日后建功回报宗门，三名提前串通的长老轮番帮腔，大半长老已经点头默许，库房丹药清单都快要动笔批注了，再晚一步资源就要被他领走！”
议事大殿巍峨宽阔，青玄宗各大峰头的掌权长老分列左右，气氛偏向苏辰一边。高台之下，苏辰一身素衫，身姿谦卑，脸上挂着恰到好处的委屈，句句离不开寒门不易、为宗门砥砺修行。不少长老被天道潜移默化影响，下意识心生怜惜，纷纷附和，觉得拿出一批淬体丹扶持天才是稳赚的买卖。
陆衍没有贸然破门大喊，在殿外稍稍驻足，梳理手里所有证据：苏辰霸占陆家祖传灵泉、暗中克扣下人月钱、纵容跟班随意殴打外门弟子、刻意散播谣言抹黑自己，一条条全都有当事人佐证。他打定主意不暴怒争吵，等管事长老落笔签字的瞬间再入场，一击破局。
殿内，一名白发丹峰长老捋着胡须缓缓开口：“苏辰天资卓绝，难得一心向道，宗门扶持理所应当，这批丹药从公共储备库划拨，即刻登记造册。”旁边两名帮腔长老立刻应声附和，眼看库房管事就要拿出名册落笔。
就在这关键时刻，陆衍掀开门帘，从容走入议事大殿。全场目光齐刷刷瞬间聚焦过来，不少长老下意识面露厌烦，在天道影响下，众人本能反感这名全网唾骂的纨绔子弟，甚至有人当场皱眉呵斥：“陆衍，议事重地岂是你随意闯入之处？速速退出去！”
苏辰见到陆衍现身，眼底飞快闪过一丝窃喜，心里暗自盘算：只要陆衍当场发怒吵闹，自己立马顺势卖惨，又能收割一大波同情气运。他故作和善起身拱手：“陆师兄莫恼，若是你也需要修炼资源，咱们可以一同向宗门申请。这番假意退让，又是在暗暗坐实陆衍小气善妒的标签。
陆衍无视周遭的呵斥与偏见，缓步走到大殿中央石桌旁，将一沓份人证笔录、下人证词平铺开来，条理清晰缓缓开口：“诸位长老想要帮扶天才无可厚非，但帮扶资源不能用来填补某人霸占私产之后的资源缺口。”
话音落下，他率先拿出灵泉地契副本，白纸黑字写明灵泉世代归属陆家，紧跟着拿出一众灵泉留守下人的签字证词，一条条列举苏辰霸占祖产、私下苛扣月钱的事实，又把前些日子苏登门上门道德绑架、妄图空白嫖丹药的经过娓娓道来，最后附上几名被跟班打伤弟子的人证记录，字字有理有据，没有半句谩骂。
苏辰脸色一点点僵硬，原本从容的谦和神态绷不住了，慌忙想要开口辩解，可证据摆在眼前，空口白话根本无从辩驳。几名提前帮苏说话的长老低头翻看证词，眉头渐渐皱起，被天道蒙蔽的认知裂开一道细小的缝隙，先前被舆论带着走的心思慢慢冷静下来。
“原来灵泉本就是陆家产业，苏师弟拿着别人的祖产，反倒跑来索要宗门补贴？”一名素来公正的木系长老喃喃自语，当场打消批拨丹药的想法。
苏辰见大势不妙，立刻重施卖惨老套路，眼眶微微泛红，想要靠着悲情博取同情，可这一次受陆衍周身功德气场干扰，周遭天道气运的倾斜力度大幅下降，飘向他的金色气运稀薄了大半，全场众人再也不像从前那样轻易被他的眼泪裹挟。大半长老开始理智权衡利弊，原本敲定的丹药审批直接搁置作废。
眼见白嫖丹药的计划彻底泡汤，苏辰满心憋屈却找不到发难的由头，只能强行维持体面，草草躬身告辞，带着心腹狼狈离开议事大殿。一场精心策划的资源掠夺，被陆衍用实打实的证据轻松化解。
议事结束后，一众长老看向陆衍的眼神悄然变化，先前根深蒂固的纨绔偏见松动不少，只是碍于天道残留影响，依旧没人当众致歉。陆衍也不纠结众人的态度，带着赵小胖从容离开大殿。
走出宗门正殿，之前被陆衍救下的外门弟子林安带着三四名交好的同伴等在路边，几人亲眼目睹议事全过程，又亲身受过陆衍恩惠，犹豫许久才上前：“陆公子，之前外界传言全是假话，我们愿意帮您私下澄清真相，只是碍于天道莫名的压迫，不敢在人多的地方发声。”
陆衍淡淡摆手，不必强求，任由真相慢慢发酵就好。几人连连道谢之后四散离开，悄悄在小范围圈子里诉说实情，一颗颗真相的种子悄悄落地。
回到陆家别院，陆衍盘膝落座，细细复盘今日两场善行：出手救助被欺压弟子、议事堂合规破局阻拦苏辰白嫖资源，两件事全都契合系统良心规则。片刻之后，系统提示音接连在脑海响起。【叮！宿主坚守本心，出手庇护弱小、合理戳破不义索求，双重良心行为生效，海量功德持续入账！】【当前功德大规模冲刷身体，天道压制削弱18%，周身常年霉运buff近乎消散，修炼速度永久性提升！】
精纯功德顺着经脉流转全身，原本卡在炼气巅峰的修为根基被持续夯实，距离突破下一个境界越来越近。陆衍调出系统面板，能清晰看见【微末气运制衡】被动效果再度增强，往后苏辰吸收天道馈赠的气运时，流失的份额变得更多。
赵小胖守在一旁，看着自家少爷修为稳步提升，乐得合不拢嘴，随手掏出刚打探来的新消息：“少爷，苏辰丹药落空之后，已经按原定计划动身前往西郊黑风幽谷，准备独占天然灵草机缘，那片幽谷现在只有他一人知晓方位，没人跟他争抢。”
陆衍眸光一动，系统先前预警的不义机缘正式现身，这正是下一轮制衡的绝佳目标。他细细询问幽谷地形、灵草成熟时间，在心里默默规划截胡方案，依旧沿用不伤人、只卡规则的老路子，不去正面打斗，靠阵法与天时抢走灵草。
就在陆敲定出行细节、准备择日动身前往黑风幽谷之时，赵小胖又补充一条重磅消息：“还有一事，再过几日各大峰开启小型资源试炼，苏已经暗中联络不少依附他的天骄，打算借着试炼抢夺全宗散落资源，继续靠着收割机缘快速拉满修为。”

After Lu Yan received the urgent report from Xiaopang, his pace suddenly quickened and he went straight to the sect's meeting hall. The merit gained from rescuing Lin An just now is still slowly flowing through the body. A faint golden light lingers around the body. The bad luck and strange things that used to haunt him from time to time have completely disappeared. Even the strong wind blowing on the road has dispersed around the body. The benefits accumulated by conscience have truly fallen on him.
Zhao Xiaopang followed closely with a thick stack of written evidence, his face flushed with anxiety: "Master, I was lying outside the hall just now to eavesdrop. Su Chen is too good at talking. He was born in a poor family, and he promised to make contributions to the sect in the future. The three elders who colluded in advance took turns to support him. Most of the elders have nodded in acquiescence. The list of elixirs in the warehouse is about to be written. If he is a step behind, the resources will be taken away by him!"
The meeting hall was majestic and spacious, with the powerful elders from the major peaks of Qingxuan Sect lined up on the left and right, and the atmosphere was on Su Chen's side. Under the high platform, Su Chen was dressed in a plain shirt, with a humble posture and just the right amount of grievance on his face. He said that he could not leave his humble family and practice hard for the sect. Many elders were subtly influenced by the way of heaven, and subconsciously felt pity for him. They all agreed, thinking that it would be a profitable business to support the genius with a batch of body tempering pills.
Lu Yan did not burst open the door and shouted. He stopped for a moment outside the palace and sorted out all the evidence in his hand: Su Chen occupied the Lu family's ancestral spiritual spring, secretly withheld monthly payments from subordinates, allowed his followers to beat outer disciples at will, and deliberately spread rumors to smear himself. All of them were supported by the parties involved. He made up his mind not to get into an angry argument and wait until the elder in charge put pen to paper before entering the room and breaking the situation with one blow.
In the hall, a white-haired Danfeng elder stroked his beard and spoke slowly: "Su Chen is extremely talented, and it is rare for him to be devoted to the Tao. The support of the sect is natural. This batch of pills will be transferred from the public reserve and registered immediately." The two elders next to him immediately echoed, and the manager of the warehouse was about to take out the list and write down it.
At this critical moment, Lu Yan opened the door curtain and walked calmly into the meeting hall. All the eyes of the audience were instantly focused, and many elders subconsciously showed disgust. Under the influence of Heaven, everyone instinctively resented this dandy boy who was reviled by the whole network. Some people even frowned and scolded on the spot: "Lu Yan, isn't this a place where you can trespass at will in an important meeting place? Get out quickly!"
Seeing Lu Yan appear, Su Chen's eyes quickly flashed with secret joy, and he secretly calculated in his heart: As long as Lu Yan gets angry and makes a noise on the spot, he will immediately take advantage of the situation and reap a lot of sympathy and luck. Pretending to be kind, he stood up and handed over his hands: "Senior Brother Lu, don't worry, if you also need cultivation resources, we can apply to the sect together. This pretended concession is secretly fulfilling the label of Lu Yan being stingy and jealous.
Lu Yan ignored the scolding and prejudice around him, walked slowly to the stone table in the center of the hall, spread out a stack of witness transcripts and servants' testimonies, and spoke clearly and slowly: "It is understandable that the elders want to help geniuses, but the assistance resources cannot be used to fill the resource gap after someone seizes private property. "
After he finished speaking, he took out a copy of the land deed of Lingquan. It stated in black and white that Lingquan had belonged to the Lu family for generations. He then took out the signed testimony of a group of left-behind servants of Lingquan, listing one by one Su Chen's seizure of the ancestral property and privately deducting a lot of money. The facts about the money were also narrated by Su Deng's moral kidnapping at his door a few days ago, in an attempt to buy pills for nothing, and finally attached the witness records of several disciples who were injured by followers. Every word was well-founded and not a word of abuse.
Su Chen's face became a little stiff, and his calm and humble demeanor could no longer be maintained. He hurriedly wanted to open his mouth to defend himself, but with the evidence in front of him, he couldn't defend himself with empty words. Several elders who had spoken to Su in advance lowered their heads and read the testimonies. Their brows gradually furrowed. A small gap opened in their understanding of being blinded by the way of heaven. Their minds that had been carried away by public opinion slowly calmed down.
"It turns out that Lingquan is the property of the Lu family, and Junior Brother Su took someone else's ancestral property and came here to ask for subsidies from the sect? "A wood elder who was always fair murmured to himself, giving up the idea of approving the elixir on the spot.
Seeing that the situation was not good, Su Chen immediately resorted to the old trick of selling out misfortune, his eyes were slightly red, trying to win sympathy with his sadness, but this time, due to the interference of Lu Yan's aura of merit and virtue, the tilt of the heavenly luck around him dropped significantly, and most of the golden luck floating towards him was thinned out. Everyone in the audience was no longer as easily affected by his tears as before. Most of the elders began to rationally weigh the pros and cons, and the originally finalized approval of the elixir was shelved and invalidated.
Seeing that the plan to get the pill for free was completely ruined, Su Chen felt aggrieved but couldn't find a reason to attack, so he could only maintain his dignity, bowed hastily to say goodbye, and left the meeting hall in embarrassment with his confidants. A well-planned resource plunder was easily resolved by Lu Yan with solid evidence.
After the discussion, the eyes of the elders looking at Lu Yan changed quietly. The previously deep-rooted dandy prejudices were loosened a lot. However, due to the residual influence of the law of heaven, no one still apologized in public. Lu Yan did not worry about everyone's attitude and calmly left the hall with Zhao Xiaopang.
Walking out of the main hall of the sect, Lin An, the outer disciple who had been rescued by Lu Yan before, was waiting by the roadside with three or four of his close friends. Several people witnessed the whole process of the discussion and received Lu Yan's favor. They hesitated for a long time before stepping forward: "Master Lu, the rumors from the outside world are all lies. We are willing to help you clarify the truth privately. However, due to the inexplicable oppression of heaven, we dare not speak out in crowded places. "
Lu Yan waved his hand calmly. There was no need to force it, just let the truth slowly ferment. Several people thanked him profusely and then dispersed, quietly telling the truth in a small circle, and the seeds of truth fell to the ground quietly.
Returning to the Lu Family Courtyard, Lu Yan sat cross-legged and reviewed the two good deeds today in detail: rescuing the oppressed disciples and breaking the rules of the meeting hall to prevent Su Chen from using prostitution resources in vain. Both of these things were in line with the rules of the system's conscience. After a while, the system prompts sounded in my mind one after another. 【bite! The host sticks to his true heart, takes action to protect the weak, reasonably exposes unjust demands, double conscience behavior takes effect, and massive merits continue to be recorded! 】【Currently, merits are washing away from the body on a large scale, the suppression of heaven is weakened by 18%, the bad luck buff all over the body has almost disappeared, and the speed of cultivation is permanently increased! 】
Pure merit flows along the meridians throughout the body, and the foundation of cultivation that was originally stuck at the peak of Qi refining is continuously consolidated, and the breakthrough to the next realm is getting closer and closer. Lu Yan brought up the system panel and could clearly see that the passive effect of [Micro Luck Check and Balance] was strengthened again. When Su Chen absorbed the luck gifted by heaven, the lost share became even greater.
Fatty Zhao stood aside and watched his young master's cultivation steadily improve. He was so happy that he took out the new information he had just found out: "Young master, after Su Chen's elixir failed, he has set off to the Black Wind Valley in the western suburbs as originally planned, preparing to monopolize the opportunity of natural spiritual grass. He is the only one who knows the location of that valley now, and no one is competing with him."
Lu Yan's eyes flickered, and the unjust opportunity that the system had previously warned about had officially appeared. This was the perfect target for the next round of checks and balances. He carefully inquired about the terrain of the valley and the maturity time of the spiritual grass, and silently planned the beard-cutting plan in his mind. He still followed the old method of not hurting anyone and only sticking to the rules. He did not engage in head-on fighting and relied on formations and timing to steal the spiritual grass.
Just when Lu was finalizing the details of his trip and preparing to leave for the Black Wind Valley on another day, Zhao Xiaopang added another piece of news: "One more thing. In a few days, the major peaks will start small resource trials. Su has secretly contacted many geniuses who rely on him. He plans to use the trials to snatch the scattered resources of the entire sect and continue to rely on harvest opportunities to quickly increase his cultivation level."
